item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 8 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades near Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Veseloye, Shilovka, Novotroitskoye, Dobropolye, Novogrishino (Donetsk People's Republic), and Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
Up to 380 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade, three air assault brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade close to Mechetnoye, Ivanovka, Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Zelenaya Dibrova, Nikolskoye, Chervony Yar, and Omelnik (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 300 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and five motor vehicles.
💥
Units of the Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade and a mountain assault brigade of the AFU near Orekhov, Yurkovka, Malokaterinovka, Yulyevka, Novoyakovlevka, and Preobrazhenka in Zaporozhye region.
▪️
More than 45 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and 14 motor vehicles of the AFU were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on
the transport and logistics infrastructure of Ukraine used by the AFU, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 148 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
12 guided aerial bombs, one U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectile, and 713 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:

▫️
1,776
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,400
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
71,340
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 🚩 Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to expand the outer ring of the encircled enemy, as a result, the control over the settlement of Dolgenkoye of Kharkov region has been gained. ▫️ The inner ring continues to shrink, and Berezniki of Kharkov region has been taken under control by Russian troops. 💥 In addition, inside the 'pocket' units of the enemy were hit close to Malaya Volchya, Varvarovka, Buzovo, and Nefedovka in Kharkov region. ▪️ During the day, the AFU losses amounted to up to 30 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two ATVs, and three unmanned aerial vehicle command posts. item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29276

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to expand the outer ring of the encircled enemy, as a result, the control over the settlement of Dolgenkoye of Kharkov region has been gained.
▫️
The inner ring continues to shrink, and
Berezniki of Kharkov region has been taken under control by Russian troops.
💥
In addition,
inside the 'pocket' units of the enemy were hit
close to Malaya Volchya, Varvarovka, Buzovo, and Nefedovka in Kharkov region.
▪️
During the day, the AFU losses amounted to up to 30 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two ATVs, and three unmanned aerial vehicle command posts. All attempts of the enemy to break through the encirclement have been thwarted.
🔥
In Sumy region, Russian elements engaged
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Luzhki, Ulanovo, Ivolzhanskoye, and Kiyanitsa (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, up to 180 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and eight motor vehicles were neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade near Osinovo, Petrovka, Kovalevka, Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region), Glubokaya Makatikha, Krymki, Bogorodichnoye, Sidorovo, and Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 190 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted fire damage on formations of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade, and an assault regiment of the AFU near Slavyansk, Cherevkovka, Kramatorsk, Druzhkovka, Nikanorovka, Nikolayevka, and Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 190 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 17 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike with ground, air, and sea-based high-precision weapons, as well as long-range drones, which hit the facilities of the Ukrainian defence industry used in the production and storage of unmanned aerial vehicles and cruise missiles, transport, logistics, and distribution centres for military cargo in Kiev and Kiev region, as well as facilities in the port of Chernomorsk in Odessa region used for the unloading of military cargo. 💥 In addition, one tanker with fuel and lubricants for the AFU was neutralised. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
